We have applied 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (each is a product of applying template forward? Actually apply_template returns possible precursors? The tool applies retrosynthetic template to a molecule, returning possible precursors. The result shows tuples of SMILES strings. For 29646 we got three possible outcomes: each is a tuple with one SMILES? Actually result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO',))"

So three possible precursors each a single SMILES. Choose one that can be further processed by next template 1914389. We attempted applying 1914389 to first precursor (with silyl group) and got two possible precursors: a silyl-protected fragment and a side product? Actually result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'),)". So applying 1914389 gave two fragments: one is the core with silyl, the other is an ester/ phosphonate? That seems like a disconnection.

Now next template 1914390 should be applied to the result of previous step? The order is fixed: after 1914389, we must apply 1914390 to each resulting fragment? Probably to the fragment that is not yet broken further.

We attempted applying 1914390 to "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC" but got no result. Maybe need to apply to the other fragment "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C". That gave no result earlier. So maybe need to choose a different precursor from 29646.

Let's try applying 1914389 to second precursor: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO". It gave no result earlier. Third also no.

Thus maybe the correct path is: 29646 -> first precursor (with silyl). Then 1914389 splits into two fragments: fragment A (core) and fragment B (some side chain). Then 1914390 should be applied to fragment B? But we tried and got none. Maybe need to apply 1914390 to fragment A after deprotect? Or maybe need to apply 149040 next to fragment A? Actually order: after 1914389, then 1914390, then 149040, then 1914391.

We have applied 149040 to the core with silyl and got two fragments: core without silyl and a sulfonyl fluoride? Actually result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO', 'CC(C)(C)[Si](C)(C)OS(=O)(=O)C(F)(F)F'),)". So fragment A: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO" (core without silyl). Fragment B: a silyl sulfonyl fluoride reagent.

Now we need to apply 1914391 to something. Let's see what 1914391 does. We haven't used it yet. We need to apply it to the core maybe to break further.
